name: United Nations

flag.description: A light blue field with the white emblem of the United Nations in the centre: a world map seen from above the North Pole, framed by two olive branches.
flag.symbolism: The map shows all the peoples of the world, and the olive branches stand for peace.

hook: The UN shows the whole world from above the North Pole in white on sky blue, cradled in olive branches; Somalia's light blue holds just a single white star.
trivia: The emblem's map is an azimuthal projection centred on the North Pole and cut off at 60° south, so Antarctica does not appear.
Outside the headquarters in New York, the flags of the member states fly in English alphabetical order, from Afghanistan to Zimbabwe.
